reference_materials: Manufacturer 93003 photograph and catalogue page 8 inspected locally; source image and package artwork are not redistributed.
findings: All nine current captures inspected: capped front/back/oblique, separated cap from two views, two source-density stock shapes and two empty-nozzle views.

The silver taper, hanging aperture and pale ribbed cap follow the product photograph. The model has independently laid-out identification text; the source artwork and textured sealed tail are not reproduced.
No official package dimensions were retrieved. The 54 by 32 by 152 mm envelope, shoulder, internal wall and thread are inferred, not measurements of the manufacturer object.
TDS and SDS density values remain conflicting source scenarios. Each stock shape represents the same 85 g tube; changing views adds no stock.
The nozzle cutaway hides the stock for inspection. Its open bore, hollow cap and separate bottom are visible; this is not a dispensing operation.
Both nominal stock shapes fit inside the cavity with the declared visualization clearance. Fine material tessellation limits exported mass error; it does not establish flow or packaging performance.
The cleanup inspector link was added; all nine re-rendered container captures remain byte-identical to the preceding inspected release.
geometry_limits: Shoulder contour, cap proportions, sealed-tail texture, wall thickness and thread engagement require dimensioned reference or measurement to establish exact fidelity.
The TDS-to-SDS density discrepancy is unresolved; no averaging or temperature explanation is asserted.

EPDM channel selection excludes the silicone door gasket. A separately assigned spatula and shared 300-wipe pack are now selected downstream. Actual cable-jacket compatibility, seal performance, application and trial/reset budgets remain open.
No tube deformation, grease transfer, dynamic support or robot qualification.
